title: Bear cub wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='24' r='11' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='24' r='11' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='24' r='6' fill='#C49A6C'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='24' r='6' fill='#C49A6C'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='30' ry='28' fill='#A0724A'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#D4B483'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#4A2E1A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#8B6B4A'/>

  <path d='M44 61 Q50 66 56 61' stroke='#4A2E1A' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='58' cy='40' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#3A3A6E' opacity='0.8'/>

  <circle cx='25' cy='54' r='4' fill='#E8A0A0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='54' r='4' fill='#E8A0A0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#A0724A'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#D4B483'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='80' rx='8' ry='10' fill='#8B5E3C' transform='rotate(20 26 80)'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='80' rx='8' ry='10' fill='#8B5E3C' transform='rotate(-20 74 80)'/>
  <!-- paws -->

  <circle cx='77' cy='87' r='5' fill='#C49A6C'/>
